_readme: ROUTE RULES (owner 2026-10-13: "everything must be configurable manually; nothing automatic unless you ask for it - many people play their own way"). Per party (key = party leader) what the bots may do on a computed route (raid travel, circuit, npc / quest / area trips through the nav atlas). Read live by swarm.js (routeRulesNow, every 30 s). Edited on the dashboard: route view -> Route rules (POST /api/routerules). A party without an entry uses 'defaults'. Missing file = the same defaults (built into swarm.js RSM_RULES; Dashboard/routeview_api.js RR_BUILTIN).

rules.label: Tower of Insolence: use the Dimensional Vortex
rules.help: Buys Dimensional Stones at Keplon (100,000 adena per character per jump, the party option) and jumps from the ground floor straight to the floor of the target (up to the 10th) instead of the climb. Green = floors 2-3, Blue = 4-6, Red = 7-10.

rules.label: Pass closed doors
rules.help: off = a closed door on the way stops the route (BLOCKED) — the bots never touch a door

rules.label: Wait at timed doors
rules.help: doors that open and close by themselves (Garden of Eva, Cruma): wait for the open phase

rules.label: Ask the door NPC
rules.help: doors a gatekeeper NPC opens (Pagan Temple gate)

rules.label: Unlock doors (dagger class)
rules.help: a Rogue / Treasure Hunter / Plains Walker ... casts Unlock (skill 27, uses Thief Keys)

rules.label: Use key items on doors
rules.help: a key item from the bag (it may be used up)

rules.label: Buy the keys a route's doors need
rules.help: on = before leaving town the Unlock member buys the Thief Keys THIS route's Unlock doors need (by his Unlock level, 2 tries a door) at the nearest grocer; nothing is bought for routes without such doors (owner 2026-10-13)

rules.label: Swim when there is no dry way
rules.help: off = a route that swims is not used (Tillion, the Garden of Eva dive): the old travel code is tried instead

rules.label: Drop off ledges
rules.help: off = a route with a one-way drop is not used (drops over 333 cost HP, never below 1 HP)

rules.label: Walk out of Heine on foot
rules.help: off = the old rule: only Heine's gatekeeper takes the party out

rules.label: Try fortress gates
rules.help: on = a route that goes around a fortress (Valley Fortress: Sejarr's Servitor, Nakondas) takes the shorter way through its gates; a closed gate stops the route (only the owner clan opens them; unknown whether they are open without an owner on your server)

rules.label: Move together: wait for everyone at every waypoint
rules.help: on (recommended, also in the public package: it keeps the team safe) = every member walks the same waypoints; the leader waits at each one until everyone is there (max 60 s for a slow walker; a stuck member gets side-step / re-plan / step back, after 90 s it catches up by itself). Off = the old way: everyone walks the points at its own pace and the team meets at the end

rules.label: Move together: longest wait at one waypoint
rules.help: how long the leader waits at a waypoint for a member that is still walking; after that the team goes on and the slow member follows on the same points (a stuck member or a swimmer is always waited for)

rules.label: Move together: go on without a stuck member after
rules.help: a member that cannot get past a spot tries side-step, a new way, a step back; after this many seconds the team goes on and it catches up by itself (own way, else .town) — said in party chat; never in the water

rules.label: Move together: the leader slows down when someone is this far behind
rules.help: distance along the route; the leader stops until the member is closer (1 metre is about 40 units in game)

rules.label: Move together: "stuck" after this many seconds without getting closer
rules.help: then the member starts its unstick steps (in the water always after 4 s)
